summary: Master procurement analytics and spend management. Learn to build spend cubes, optimize sourcing, and mitigate risk with data. Enroll in our 5-day course.
lede: Spend management training covers how procurement professionals use purchasing data to guide sourcing decisions and identify cost opportunities. Designed for sourcing managers, category managers and procurement analysts, it builds practical skills in cleaning and classifying spend data, spotting savings and contract leakage, assessing supplier risk, and presenting findings through executive dashboards.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for experienced professionals who manage significant spend portfolios and require advanced analytical capabilities to drive organizational value.
modules: Procurement Data Architecture and Spend Visibility
Advanced Spend Analysis and Opportunity Assessment
Predictive Analytics and AI in Procurement
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 5 years of experience in procurement, supply chain, or finance roles. A working knowledge of Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs) is required. Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics) is highly recommended. No prior programming or data science experience is necessary, as the course focuses on operational application rather than technical engineering.
